title: Speak for 5 Minutes
description: Build English speaking confidence with a guided five-minute speaking routine using familiar topics and simple sentence prompts.
learning_objectives: Connect ideas with simple linking words

body_markdown:
## 1. The five-minute speaking plan

You do not need difficult words. Choose a familiar topic and keep speaking in simple, complete sentences.

- Minute 1: Introduce the topic.
- Minute 2: Give basic details.
- Minute 3: Share an example or experience.
- Minute 4: Explain your opinion or feelings.
- Minute 5: Summarise the main points.

## 2. Choose a topic

Try one of these:

- My daily routine
- My family
- My workplace
- My village or city
- A person I respect
- Why I am learning English

## 3. Example opening: My workplace

“I work in a busy place. My work starts at ______. My main responsibilities are ______. I work with different people every day. Good communication is important because ______.”

Continue with a real example from your own experience. Do not memorise or invent details.

## 4. Connect your ideas

Use simple linking words:

- First, I want to talk about…
- Also, I would like to mention…
- For example…
- Because of this…
- Finally…

## 5. If you get stuck

Use a pause and restart with a simple phrase:

- Let me explain that.
- Another important point is…
- What I mean is…
- I will give an example.

## 6. Self-review

Record your five-minute talk. Check: Did you stay on topic? Were your sentences complete? Did you speak clearly? Note two improvements for tomorrow.

faq.question: What if I cannot speak for five minutes?
faq.answer: Start with one minute, then increase the time gradually as your confidence improves.

faq.question: Should I prepare a full script?
faq.answer: Use short notes or prompts instead of memorising every sentence. This helps you speak naturally.

faq.question: What should I do when I forget a word?
faq.answer: Explain the idea using simpler words, or pause briefly and continue.
